body.objective: Determine whether the positive public BT three-particle source can be pulled back to a genuine perfect-square scalar projector with the certified formal Rt inverse, transfer the leading detector effect to that scalar source, and identify exactly which Eq. 19 hypothesis the construction does or does not retain.
activates: an Rt-affiliated positive perfect-square scalar source on the finite covariant detector ideal
a transferred leading scalar click/no-click probability jet
an exact theorem that positive odd-particle preparations must break boost/shift charge on the cross-Krein carrier
body.current_gate: Construct P_phi=Rt^dagger P_u Rt and the pulled effects on the exact three-particle cross-Krein carrier; prove the commuting square, finite-trace equality, Laurent orbit support, and the charge-invariant positivity obstruction without treating an arbitrary isometry fixture as the public Rt.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate with an independent verifier that proves or refutes scalar source affiliation and probability transfer for the declared dressed source. If it succeeds, distinguish it from the shift-invariant characteristic projector P_chi and from a proof of general Eq. 19; if it fails, identify the first exact domain, charge, projector, or trace obstruction.
body.forbid: no abstract isometry fixture called the public Rt; no Rt-pulled dressed source called the standard shift-invariant P_chi; no selected finite detector-ideal identity called general Eq. 19; no leading probability jet called an all-time S matrix; no gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
body.resource_hint: On the eight three-particle species strings use eta=kappa_3, q(x)=2 popcount(x)-3 and u0=(|0>+|7>)/sqrt(2). Its Krein projector P_u has operator-charge support {-6,0,+6}. Every fixed nonzero-charge eigenspace is eta-isotropic, so no nonzero charge-invariant range can be positive. Use the certified formal identities Rt^dagger Rt=Rt Rt^dagger=1 to set psi_phi=Rt^dagger u0, P_phi=Rt^dagger P_u Rt and E_phi=Rt^dagger E_BT Rt. Verify pushforward, normalization, projector identities and trace equality universally; use a nontrivial exact Krein-isometry fixture only as a falsifiable replay of those identities.
